parsed.rationale: Customer requests the ability to schedule weekly exports directly to an S3 bucket instead of manually downloading CSVs; they state it is not blocking and would only save time.

parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the feature request—scheduling weekly exports directly to your S3 bucket would definitely streamline the workflow. I’ve noted your request to support automated, scheduled exports to S3 (instead of manual CSV downloads) so your team can save time each week.

To help us route this to the right place, could you confirm a couple of details?
1) Which data/export type(s) are you looking to schedule (e.g., reports, datasets, specific tables)?
2) Do you want the job to run on a fixed schedule (e.g., every Monday) and should it create one file per run or append/aggregate into a single file?

Once we have that, we can share it with the team that manages export capabilities. This is not blocking on your side, so we’ll focus on collecting the needed specifics and progressing the request.
promised_actions: Log and route the feature request internally for scheduled exports to S3
Request the minimum needed details to clarify the export type and output format/schedule
safety_notes: No promises about delivery timeline or availability of S3 scheduling are made.
